primary_itt.resampling: paired accepted starts, whole parent-family clusters; starts weighted equally
primary_itt.simultaneous_scope: twelve contrasts within this endpoint only

at_least_one_reader_sensitivity.resampling: paired accepted starts, whole parent-family clusters; starts weighted equally
at_least_one_reader_sensitivity.simultaneous_scope: twelve contrasts within this endpoint only

position_sensitivity.interpretation: Descriptive position sensitivity; no independent position allocation claim.

claim_limit: One local action tests a causal response at accepted starts. If fewer than 128 families were accepted, the registered 128-family validation is infeasible and this is an exploratory subset. No second transition or action-order claim. Semantic ratings are Qwen3.8 audits, not human truth; bootstrap intervals are approximate and do not establish a second transition or action-order effect.
